notes.title: UFO-Man Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45104500/69d37ddaea278927586df4021ed7387f49077937.png[/img]

The challenging foddian game UFO-Man is [b]released today, 25 October 2024[/b]!
For one week from today, the game is available at [b]a launch sale price of 15% off[/b]!

If you like foddian games like "Getting Over It", you'll be fascinated by this super-challenging difficulty!
Enjoy!

notes.title: UFO-Man Releases on 25th October 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45104500/ad95c7d2b9b00e1de2b40cf7a8faacb73887522e.png[/img]

The simple yet challenging new Foddian game, UFO-Man, [b]releases on 25th October 2024[/b]!
For one week after release, we have a [b]15% OFF launch sale[/b]!

Also, we are currently [b]offering a free demo[/b].
It’s available for everyone, so be sure to download and give it a try!
